units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 5a:8">M. Kat. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ אין וכ׳</he> cleaning is permitted, but digging &c.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 5a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ מי שרי</he> is cleaning permitted?; a. e.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:17">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 25a:14">Ḥull. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>מחוסר ח׳</he> a block requiring hollowing out for becoming a receptacle.

<cite ref="Chullin 25a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>מחוסר ח׳ פשיטא</he> is it not a matter of course that a block requiring hollowing out is not fit for uncleanness?; v. <cite ref="H00608"><he>חֲטַט</he></cite>.
